tldr: 最近交易日（8/21 週五）加權指數大漲 291 點、0.65% 收 45,224 點站回 45,000 關卡，外資連二買、加碼貨櫃三雄。
台積電指引 2026 營收成長約三成、AI 相關營收 2029 年前年複合增速近 60%，帶動 CoWoS 封裝、液冷、PCB 與 HBM 供應鏈全面受惠。
金管會優化銀行與金控財報準則、推動保險資金投入公共建設，國際私銀則加大搶攻台灣高資產財管市場的力道。
立法院 8/21 三讀通過《遺產及贈與稅法》與《所得稅法》修正，收緊死亡前 2 年贈與併計遺產規定並調整免稅額，牽動高資產傳承與家庭稅務規劃。
最近交易日（8/21 週五）美股三大指數在殖利率趨穩下同步反彈，市場焦點轉向輝達 8/26 財報與聯準會 Jackson Hole 談話。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲 291 點收 45,224、外資加碼貨櫃
items.title_en: TAIEX jumps 291 points to 45,224 as foreign buyers pile into shippers
items.summary_zh: 最近交易日（8/21 週五）加權指數開低走高、收漲 0.65% 至 45,224 點站回 45,000 點。三大法人合計買超約 331 億元，外資連二買、單日約買超 283 億元。台積電漲 35 元收 2,410 元（+1.47%），貨櫃股陽明、萬海居外資買超前列，顯示資金在 AI 權值股之外轉進景氣循環族群，盤面族群輪動、多方氣勢延續。
items.summary_en: In the most recent session (Friday, Aug 21) Taiwan's benchmark opened lower but closed up 0.65% at 45,224, retaking the 45,000 level. The three major institutions net-bought around NT$331 billion, with foreign investors adding roughly NT$28 billion for a second straight day of buying. TSMC rose NT$35 to NT$2,410 (+1.47%), while container lines Yang Ming and Wan Hai led foreign purchases, signalling a rotation into cyclicals alongside AI heavyweights.

items.title_zh: 外資連二買、加碼貨櫃雙雄、調節漢翔
items.title_en: Foreign investors extend buying streak, adding container "big two" and trimming AIDC
items.summary_zh: 外資週五連續第二個交易日買超，火力集中貨櫃股陽明（買超約 3.7 萬張）、萬海（約 1.6 萬張），同時調節漢翔。資金明顯偏向航運族群，反映對運價回穩的預期，也顯示盤面領漲類股由半導體向外擴散；台股守穩 45,000 點進入週末，題材輪動有助後市多空拉鋸中維持人氣。
items.summary_en: Foreign institutions logged a second consecutive day of net buying on Friday, concentrating on the container shippers Yang Ming (+37,000 lots) and Wan Hai (+16,000 lots) while paring positions in Aerospace Industrial Development. The tilt toward freight names reflects bets on firming shipping rates and a broadening of leadership beyond semiconductors as the market holds above 45,000 into the weekend.

items.title_zh: 台積電指引 2026 營收增約三成、AI 營收年複合近 60%
items.title_en: TSMC guides to ~30% 2026 revenue growth as AI sales compound near 60%
items.summary_zh: 台積電重申 2026 全年營收成長上看近三成，並預估 2024～2029 年 AI 相關營收年複合增速接近 60%。先進封裝產能同步快速擴充，CoWoS 月產能上看 10 萬片以上。此指引鞏固台積電在全球 AI 硬體建置中的核心地位，也為整條台廠 AI 供應鏈的中長期成長定錨，強化市場對獲利能見度的信心。
items.summary_en: TSMC management reiterated a near-30% revenue growth outlook for 2026 and projected AI-related revenue to compound at close to 60% annually from 2024 to 2029. Advanced-packaging capacity is scaling fast, with CoWoS monthly output guided toward 100,000-plus wafers, cementing Taiwan's foundry leadership as the anchor of the global AI hardware build-out.

items.title_zh: AI 題材由 GPU 外溢至散熱、電源與先進封裝
items.title_en: AI theme broadens from GPUs to cooling, power and advanced packaging
items.summary_zh: 2026 年市場焦點自 GPU、AI 伺服器擴散至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB/CCL、電源供應與 48V 高壓供電、HBM/CoWoS 及矽光子。由於部分低毛利先進封裝製程外包，日月光投控等後段封測廠持續受惠 CoS 訂單。此趨勢使 AI 受惠族群由運算晶片向更廣泛台廠零組件擴散，帶動材料、散熱、電源等次族群輪番表現。
items.summary_en: Market focus in 2026 is spreading beyond GPUs and AI servers to rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply and 48V high-voltage delivery, HBM/CoWoS and silicon photonics. As lower-margin advanced-packaging steps are partly outsourced, back-end players such as ASE continue to win CoS orders, widening the set of Taiwanese hardware names riding the AI capex wave.

items.title_zh: 金管會優化銀行與金控財報編製準則
items.title_en: FSC refines bank and financial-holding reporting standards
items.summary_zh: 金管會於 8 月修正銀行及金控公司財務報告編製準則，並更新信用合作社相關規範，以提升資訊揭露的透明度與可比較性。相關調整為金融業接軌新一代會計與清償能力制度鋪路，促使機構提升資產負債表揭露品質。此舉牽動整體金融業體質與後續監理節奏，也讓投資人更易比較各行庫的財務體質。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission amended the preparation standards for financial reports of banks and financial holding companies and updated credit-cooperative regulations in August, aiming to improve disclosure transparency and comparability. The changes form part of the groundwork as the sector moves toward new accounting and solvency frameworks, nudging institutions toward cleaner, more consistent balance-sheet reporting.

items.title_zh: 金管會推動保險資金投入公共建設
items.title_en: Regulators move to channel insurance funds into public construction
items.summary_zh: 金管會表示正跨部會研議擴大保險業參與公共建設投資，為壽險資金提供長天期去化管道，同時支持基礎建設融資。此舉意在使壽險業長期負債與穩定現金流資產相互匹配，紓解低利與再投資壓力。在接軌新清償能力制度之際，導引保險資金投入公建，兼顧產業穩健與國家建設資金需求，具政策雙重效益。
items.summary_en: The FSC said it is working across departments to expand insurers' participation in public-construction investment, providing long-duration outlets for insurance capital while supporting infrastructure financing. The initiative aims to match life insurers' long-term liabilities with stable, cash-flow-generating assets, easing reinvestment pressure as the industry transitions to the new solvency regime.

items.title_zh: 亞資高峰論壇：銀行看好私募市場與家族辦公室
items.title_en: Banks bullish on private markets and family offices at Asia wealth summit
items.summary_zh: 2026 亞資高峰論壇上，台灣銀行業呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財管服務，並點名私募股權、私募債權、避險基金與家族辦公室服務仍是與國際私銀相比的缺口。玉山等業者陸續推出「資產池」概念的多元資產擔保融資與不特定受益人信託，針對高資產家族的跨境稅務與傳承需求提供解方，反映財管競爭由商品銷售升級至整合式家族服務。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Asian Assets Summit, Taiwanese banks urged wider allocation to alternative assets and deeper cross-border wealth services, flagging private equity, private credit, hedge funds and family-office solutions as gaps versus international private banks. Domestic players including E.Sun are rolling out asset-pool collateralised lending and non-specified-beneficiary trusts to serve high-net-worth families with cross-border tax and succession needs.

items.title_zh: KPMG：台灣高資產財富規模將持續擴張
items.title_en: KPMG: Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth pool set to keep expanding
items.summary_zh: KPMG《2026 台灣財富管理趨勢報告》預估，受惠科技業企業家與新富階層帶動，台灣高資產人口與資產規模將延續結構性成長，並使台灣逐步成為亞洲資產管理重要樞紐。報告建議銀行擴大另類投資、海外商品與傳承規劃布局，以承接快速成長的財管市場。此趨勢凸顯財管業者深化跨境與高階服務、爭取高資產客群的長期機會。
items.summary_en: KPMG's 2026 Taiwan Wealth Management Report projects continued structural growth in the island's high-net-worth population and assets, driven by tech-sector entrepreneurs and new wealth. The report positions Taiwan as an emerging Asian asset-management hub and urges banks to broaden alternatives, offshore products and succession planning to capture the fast-growing pool.
items.source_name: KPMG 台灣財富管理趨勢報告 2026

items.title_zh: 立法院修法收緊死亡前 2 年贈與、併計遺產課稅
items.title_en: Legislature tightens two-year deathbed-gift rules in estate-tax overhaul
items.summary_zh: 立法院於 8/21（週五）三讀通過《遺產及贈與稅法》部分條文修正，明定被繼承人死亡前 2 年內贈與特定親屬的財產須併計遺產課稅，並由受贈人負擔稅負，課稅級距亦隨累計通膨調整。此修法收緊臨終前贈與的套利空間，對高資產族群的傳承、信託與保單布局影響重大，家族財富規劃須及早因應新制。
items.summary_en: On Friday, Aug 21, Taiwan's legislature passed amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act, formalising that gifts of certain property to specified relatives within two years before death are counted back into the taxable estate, with the recipient bearing the tax; brackets were also adjusted for cumulative inflation. The change curbs deathbed-gifting arbitrage and is material for high-net-worth succession and trust planning.

items.title_zh: 《所得稅法》修正、調整子女免稅額與保費扣除
items.title_en: Income Tax Act amendments revise child exemption and insurance-premium deductions
items.summary_zh: 立法院同日（8/21）三讀通過《所得稅法》第 17 條、第 126 條修正，調整未成年子女免稅額與保險費列舉扣除額規定。此調整可望減輕家庭稅負，並為本週密集的財稅立法再添一項。家庭理財與保險規劃可留意相關額度變化，及早試算對明年報稅的影響，妥善配置保單與扣除項目。
items.summary_en: The legislature also passed amendments to Articles 17 and 126 of the Income Tax Act on Aug 21, revising rules on the exemption for minor children and the itemised deduction for insurance premiums. The adjustments ease the household tax burden and add to a busy week of fiscal legislation; households should watch the applicable thresholds when planning next year's filing.

items.title_zh: 台灣出口續強、AI 帶動電子出口年增 55.5%
items.title_en: Taiwan exports stay red-hot as AI demand lifts electronics shipments 55.5%
items.summary_zh: 台灣出口動能強勁，8 月電子與資通訊產品出口年增 55.5%，連續第 4 個月成長逾 50%，推升整體商品出口約 34.1%。動能來自 AI、高效能運算（HPC）與半導體先進製程的強勁需求，為經濟成長與企業資本支出提供支撐。此趨勢強化市場對下半年景氣的信心，也使出口導向類股與供應鏈續受資金青睞。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's exports remained strong, with electronics and ICT product exports up 55.5% year-on-year in August — a fourth straight month above 50% — helping push total goods exports about 34.1% higher. The momentum is driven by AI, high-performance computing and advanced-semiconductor demand, underpinning GDP growth and corporate capex into the second half.

items.title_zh: 通膨可控近 2%、智庫看政策穩定
items.title_en: Inflation seen contained near 2% as think-tanks flag steady policy
items.summary_zh: 智庫預測台灣 2026 全年 CPI 年增率約 1.98%，受油價補貼與電費凍漲抑制物價；7 月 CPI 年增 2.54%。經濟成長走勢「前高後穩」，在外需強勁下，央行有空間維持利率不變。整體總經環境對股市與內需偏向有利，惟仍須留意國際油價、地緣政治與主要央行政策對後續物價與資金面的影響，審慎看待波動。
items.summary_en: Forecasters expect Taiwan's 2026 CPI to run near 1.98%, with fuel subsidies and frozen electricity tariffs capping price pressure; July CPI rose 2.54% year-on-year. Growth is projected to be front-loaded across the year, giving the central bank room to keep rates steady amid robust external demand, a broadly supportive backdrop for equities and domestic consumption.

items.title_zh: 貝森特擬擴大美債回購、油價登一個月高點主導風險情緒
items.title_en: Treasury buybacks and a one-month oil high steer global risk mood
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體引述外電報導，美國財長貝森特釋出可能擴大美債回購以穩定長天期殖利率的訊號；同期油價升至一個月高位、金價走勢不定，美股當日收跌，反映美債經歷震盪的一週。此發展凸顯債市管理與地緣政治正主導全球風險情緒，牽動資金在股、債與商品之間的配置，投資人對利率與供給面消息高度敏感。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media, citing overseas wires, reported that US Treasury Secretary Bessent signalled potentially larger Treasury buybacks to steady long-end yields, while oil climbed to a one-month high and gold traded choppily and US stocks slipped in one session during a volatile week for bonds. The moves highlight how debt-market management and geopolitics are driving cross-asset sentiment.

items.title_zh: 沃爾瑪重挫拖累道瓊、消息敏感週分化明顯
items.title_en: Walmart plunge drags Dow lower earlier in a headline-sensitive week
items.summary_zh: 本週稍早，台灣媒體引述美媒報導，沃爾瑪因財測不佳暴跌約 9%，拖累道瓊重挫逾 700 點，但費城半導體指數續強、台積電 ADR 收紅，抗跌力道較佳。此分化凸顯盤面題材輪動、對消息面高度敏感；在科技股財報與央行談話焦點週登場前，市場保持謹慎，台灣相關 AI 供應鏈仍受海外資金關注。
items.summary_en: Earlier in the week, US media relayed by Taiwanese outlets reported the Dow tumbling more than 700 points as Walmart sank about 9% on a weak outlook, though Taiwan-linked chip names such as TSMC's ADR and the SOX index held up better. The split underscored a rotation-heavy, headline-sensitive tape ahead of a pivotal stretch of tech earnings and central-bank commentary.

items.title_zh: 美股週五反彈、殖利率趨穩（2026-08-21，最近交易日）
items.title_en: US stocks rebound Friday as Treasury yields steady (2026-08-21, most recent trading day)
items.summary_zh: 最近交易日（8/21 週五）美股三大指數同步走高，標普 500 漲 0.43% 收 7,674.37 點、那斯達克漲 0.43% 收 26,180.45 點，道瓊上漲 517.80 點、0.98% 收 53,277.01 點，收復債市震盪一週的部分失地。默克、嬌生等醫療類股撐盤，美債殖利率回穩帶動風險情緒改善。
items.summary_en: In the most recent US session (Friday, Aug 21) the S&P 500 rose 0.43% to 7,674.37 and the Nasdaq gained 0.43% to 26,180.45, while the Dow added 517.80 points, or 0.98%, to 53,277.01, clawing back after a tumultuous week for Treasurys. Healthcare names such as Merck and Johnson & Johnson supported the blue-chip index as bond yields stabilised.

items.title_zh: 輝達 8/26 財報登場、市場下一個 AI 大考（2026-08-21）
items.title_en: Nvidia's Aug 26 earnings loom as the market's next big AI test (2026-08-21)
items.summary_zh: 輝達將於美東 8/26（週三）盤後公布會計年度第二季財報，華爾街預估營收約 930～950 億美元、年增近 96%。投資人聚焦 Blackwell 平台放量與需求展望；財報若優於預期，可望重燃晶片族群的 AI 行情，反之則恐引發科技股回檔。此財報為近期全球風險情緒的關鍵變數，牽動台鏈 AI 供應商後市表現，值得密切留意。
items.summary_en: Nvidia is set to report fiscal second-quarter results on Wednesday, Aug 26 after the close, with Wall Street modelling roughly US$93–95 billion in revenue, near 96% year-on-year growth. Investors are focused on the Blackwell ramp and the demand outlook; a strong print could reignite the AI rally across chip peers, while a disappointment risks a broader technology pullback.

items.title_zh: 市場等待聯準會 Jackson Hole 談話尋找利率線索（2026-08-21）
items.title_en: Markets await the Fed's Jackson Hole address for rate-path clues (2026-08-21)
items.summary_zh: 投資人聚焦聯準會在 Jackson Hole 全球央行年會的談話，尋找利率路徑與央行獨立性訊號；此前美債震盪，10 年期殖利率一度逼近多年高點。市場正評估 9 月政策動向的機率，若語氣偏鴿，可望壓低殖利率、弱化美元並激勵股市，反之若偏審慎，則可能再度加劇市場波動，牽動全球股債走向。
items.summary_en: Investors are looking to the Federal Reserve's Jackson Hole remarks for signals on the interest-rate path and central-bank independence, after a volatile stretch that pushed the 10-year Treasury yield near multi-year highs. Markets are debating the odds of a September policy move; a dovish tone could ease yields, soften the dollar and lift equities, while a cautious message risks renewed volatility.
